text:
jen_support: Customer reports promo email + UI confirmation after entering voucher but account usage/balance still shows 0. Customer ID: C-98122, promo token: TRIAL-JUNE-042. They attached the confirmation screenshot and a timestamped API request id: req_0a3f9b.

ryan_engineer: thanks jen. Can you paste the full redemption payload (headers + body) or the request id? I want to check the webhook and ledger side. Did they use the web UI or the CLI?

jen_support: web UI. Here is the redemption POST we logged (sanitized):
```json
{
  "customer_id": "C-98122",
  "promo_code": "TRIAL-JUNE-042",
  "amount": 10000,
  "currency": "USD"
}
```
Request header x-request-id: req_0a3f9b. They got the green "Redeemed!" UI toast and a confirmation email at 2026-06-03T14:12:08Z.

oncall-bot: webhook-delivery failed for event=promo.redeemed id=evt_44f1 status=502 attempts=3 last_attempt=2026-06-03T14:12:09Z

ekaterina_billing: ledger shows no credit applied. I queried ledger for C-98122 between 2026-06-03T00:00 and 2026-06-04T00:00: no entries with promo_id TRIAL-JUNE-042. Looks like redemption recorded in promo service but the apply-to-ledger job didn't succeed.

ryan_engineer: makes sense. The webhook worker is our glue between promo-service -> billing. 502 from billing API likely caused retries to exhaust. We should: 1) confirm webhook payload in promo-service (jen provided) 2) re-run billing webhook consumer on a small window for this event 3) if missing, run adhoc ledger apply with `billingctl apply-promo --customer C-98122 --promo TRIAL-JUNE-042 --id evt_44f1`

jen_support: can you run the steps? customer is waiting and asked for ETA.

ryan_engineer: running consumer replay for that event now. Command: `k run job replay-webhooks --env=prod --filter=evt_44f1`

ryan_engineer: replay output (tail):
```
2026-06-03T14:15:12Z INFO replaying evt_44f1
2026-06-03T14:15:12Z ERROR billing-api: 502 Bad Gateway
2026-06-03T14:16:00Z INFO retrying (attempt 2)
2026-06-03T14:16:00Z ERROR billing-api: 502 Bad Gateway
2026-06-03T14:17:30Z INFO fallback: writing to manual_apply queue
```
ryan_engineer: looks like the billing edge had an intermittent 502 during that minute. I pushed the event to manual_apply queue and ran the safe apply now: `billingctl apply-promo --customer C-98122 --promo TRIAL-JUNE-042 --event evt_44f1 --dry-run=false`

ryan_engineer: apply output: `OK: credit applied 10000 USD to C-98122 (ledger_tx=LT-20260603-9F7)`

jen_support: awesome. Can you confirm the customer's balance/usage now and whether they can call the API? I'll tell them.

ryan_engineer: checked ledger and the balance now shows 10000 credits available. I also simulated a short /v1/usage call and saw token billing decrement. Sample check: `GET /v1/accounts/C-98122/balance -> {"available": 10000}`

jekaterina_billing: (typo) ekaterina_billing: added ledger tx LT-20260603-9F7 and linked event evt_44f1. Please add note to the ticket that this was a webhook-delivery failure (502) and credits were applied manually. Recommend we add alerting on webhook 5xx ratio > 1% for the day.

jen_support: will DM customer and update support ticket #129014 with the ledger tx and timings. Customer wants assurance their consumed usage during the gap will be reconciled. Can we retro-apply credits for any usage consumed between confirmation email and manual apply?

ryan_engineer: we applied the promo as of the original event timestamp; billingctl supports `--effective-at=2026-06-03T14:12:08Z` to backdate. I ran it with that flag, so usage in the gap is covered.

jen_support: great, customer notified and relieved. I'll close the immediate loop.

ekaterina_billing: logging follow-up action: 1) add alerting for webhook 5xx spike; 2) investigate why billing edge returned 502 for ~5 min; 3) add an automated backfill job for failed promos older than 1h to reduce manual ops.

ryan_engineer: filing a quick postmortem (draft) and will include logs/trace ids. Assigning to eng-infra to own root cause.

jen_support: thanks all. Marking thread resolved for support. If infra needs more from us, ping here. :white_check_mark:
